common_rules.text: Food additives may be used only where permitted by the relevant Chapter 2.3 standard and Appendix A.
Products whose Chapter 2.3 clause refers to Appendix B must comply with the applicable microbiological requirements.
General Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations apply in addition to product-specific declarations.

ingredient_rules.name: Nutritive sweeteners
ingredient_rules.condition: Very acidic fruits, subject to exclusions in the standard

standards.name: Fermented Soybean Paste
standards.definition: Fermented food whose essential ingredient is soybean with the trypsin inhibitor inactivated; the product is paste-like and may be semi-solid with partly retained soybean shape.
variants: Fermented soybean paste manufactured with soybean only
Fermented soybean paste manufactured with soybean and grains
basic_ingredients: naturally occurring or cultivated non-pathogenic, non-toxin-producing Bacillus spp. and/or Aspergillus spp.
optional_ingredients: grains and/or flour as defined in sub-regulation 2.4
distilled ethyl alcohol derived from agricultural products
nutritive sugars including honey as defined in sub-regulation 2.8
process_rules: Soybean trypsin inhibitor shall be inactivated.
Product shall have characteristic flavour, odour, colour and texture.
standards.source_note: Verified against current FSSAI Chapter 2.3 and current FoSCoS mapping to FCS 12.9.1 / FSSR 2.3.57.

standards.name: Vegetable Protein Products
standards.definition: Food products produced by reducing or removing major non-protein constituents such as water, oil, starch and other carbohydrates from vegetable materials other than single-cell protein sources, to achieve protein content of at least 40%.
raw_material_rules: Prepared from clean, sound plant material free from foreign matter, or from vegetable protein products of lower protein content meeting this standard.
optional_ingredients: edible fats and oils permitted under FSSAI regulations
standards.additives: Use current Appendix A permissions for FCS 12.10 and applicable general/GMP provisions; the current indexed 2.3.59 product-standard text does not state a separate no-additives prohibition.
standards.source_note: Verified against current FSSAI Chapter 2.3 Version 3 (07.05.2025). The no-additives sentence immediately preceding 2.3.59 belongs to the preceding standard and is not assigned to Vegetable Protein Products.

standards.name: Thermally Processed Tomato Juice
standards.definition: Unfermented tomato juice mechanically obtained from sound, fresh and fully ripe tomatoes and heat-processed to prevent spoilage; may be reconstituted from concentrate.
permitted_ingredients: other ingredients standardized under the regulations
